title: Ukunyuka Komphuphi
intro: Umphefumulo owawumiselwe ubukhulu, kodwa wavivinywa yizilingo ezinzima, waqala uhambo olungavamile. Indlela yalo muntu yayiphawulwe ngomona, ukuhlukana, nokuhlupheka okungafanele, okwagcina sekuphethe isikhundla somthwalo wemfanelo omkhulu nokuhlangana kabusha okujulile. Ungamthola lo muntu ophawulekayo kwiQuran?
clues: Nganginomona ngabantu abaseduze nami, okwaholela ekuhlukaneni okukhulu nomzali wami kanye nekhaya.
Ngibhekane nesikhathi sobunzima obukhulu, okuhlanganisa nokuthengiswa ngentengo encane ngabahambi.
Ngamangalelwa ngokungafanele ngokwenza okubi futhi ngachitha iminyaka eminingi ngivalelwe, kodwa ukholo lwami lwahlala luqinile.
Nganikwa ikhono eliyingqayizivele lokuhumusha imibono eyinkimbinkimbi, eyaba wusizo endleleni yami eya enkululekweni.
Ukuhlakanipha kwami ​​​​nobuqotho bami ekugcineni kwangiholela esikhundleni segunya elikhulu nokwethenjwa ezweni langaphandle.
Phakathi nochungechunge lwezenzakalo, ngaphinde ngahlangana nomzali wami osekhulile kanye nabafowethu nodadewethu ngemuva kokungabikho isikhathi eside nobuhlungu.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
